infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Kya Khaun turns what you say into text so Chatora can understand your craving.

plugins.photosPermission: Kya Khaun uses a photo you choose to spot ingredients, suggest food for where you are, or keep a picture of a dish you cooked in My Kitchen on your phone.
